en: The image shows a bustling street scene with people dressed in early 20th-century attire, many wearing traditional Ottoman fez hats, suggesting an Ottoman-era setting. The architecture is a mix of low-rise buildings with tiled roofs and a visible minaret in the background, indicating the presence of a mosque. The street is cobblestoned, and market stalls or shops line the sides. The word 'SALONIQUE' is printed at the top, and there is a watermark with the website www.elia.org.gr.
